assumptions_challenged: That publication-level guidance (MISEV2023) constitutes program-specific evidence that SGL-001 has produced MCB/WCB characterization, fit-for-purpose intact-EV assay validations, GMP-like batch release/stability data, or in vivo bridging biodistribution with intact-EV controls.

That rodent intranasal biodistribution data alone are sufficient to predict reproducible intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species without matching validated intact-EV assays and cross-species bridging controls.
That the absence of program artifacts can be inferred from the guideline document rather than from program-submitted CMC/analytics/manufacturing records.
falsification_conditions: Provide Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) generation and full characterization/release reports demonstrating identity, purity, and absence of adventitious agents.
Provide fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV assays and orthogonal QC methods (method descriptions, LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, acceptance criteria, and validation data).

Provide representative GMP-like batch manufacturing records and release specifications for at least three batches, plus batch-to-batch comparability analysis showing reproducible critical quality attributes.
Provide stability data demonstrating stability-indicating attributes and potency across batches (timepoints, conditions, and analytical readouts showing stability or defined degradation profiles).
Provide assay correlation data linking in vitro potency readouts to an in vivo PD endpoint (or a validated surrogate), showing that the potency assay is mechanism-relevant and predictive.

Provide rodent and at least one large-animal intranasal biodistribution study reports that include controls to attribute signal to intact EV (e.g., free-label controls, degraded-EV controls, orthogonal intact-EV assays) and demonstrate reproducibility across lots/species.
Provide formulation/device compatibility studies (intact-EV recovery during device handling and delivery) with method details and acceptance criteria.
strongest_objection: The supplied evidence set contains only the MISEV2023 guidance; it does not provide any program-specific CMC, assay validation, batch, stability, or biodistribution data required to establish an evidence-linked identity and potency framework for SGL-001. Therefore the conclusion that the program meets the pre-comparability gate (or that it fails it) cannot be substantiated from the provided evidence.
